course.title: Unit 7 Happy Birthday!【例句】
course.description: SECTION B How do you make your birthday meaningful?

sentences.content: On that day, I always eat birthday noodles with eggs.
sentences.english: On that day , I always eat birthday noodles with eggs
sentences.chinese: 在那一天，我总是会吃加了鸡蛋的长寿面。

sentences.content: Long noodles are a symbol of long life.
sentences.english: Long noodles are a symbol of long life

sentences.content: Every year, my family and I take a photo together under the big tree in our village.
sentences.english: Every year , my family and I take a photo together under the big tree in our village
sentences.chinese: 每年，我和家人都会在我们村庄的那棵大树下一起合影。

sentences.content: I like taking photos because they help me remember fun times with my family.
sentences.english: I like taking photos because they help me remember fun times with my family
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢拍照，因为它们能帮我记住与家人共度的欢乐时光。

sentences.content: This year, I want to plant a small tree for my 14th birthday.
sentences.english: This year , I want to plant a small tree for my 14th birthday
sentences.chinese: 今年，我想为我的14岁生日种一棵小树。

sentences.content: I'd like to watch it grow with me.
sentences.english: I'd like to watch it grow with me
sentences.chinese: 我想看着它与我一同成长。

sentences.content: It's a great idea to plant a tree for your birthday!
sentences.english: It's a great idea to plant a tree for your birthday !
sentences.chinese: 为你的生日种一棵树，这个主意真棒！

sentences.content: I usually have a party with my friends to celebrate.
sentences.english: I usually have a party with my friends to celebrate
sentences.chinese: 我通常会和朋友们一起举办派对来庆祝。

sentences.content: My mother always makes my favourite chocolate cake.
sentences.english: My mother always makes my favourite chocolate cake
sentences.chinese: 我母亲总会做我最爱的巧克力蛋糕。

wordDetails.definition: make（第三人称单数）: 制作

sentences.content: Everyone sings the "Happy Birthday" song, and then I make a wish and blow out the candles.
sentences.english: Everyone sings the " Happy Birthday " song , and then I make a wish and blow out the candles
sentences.chinese: 大家一起唱《生日快乐》歌，然后我许愿并吹灭蜡烛。

sentences.content: Next, we enjoy the cake, and I open all my gifts.
sentences.english: Next , we enjoy the cake , and I open all my gifts
sentences.chinese: 接下来，我们享用蛋糕，我拆开了所有礼物。

sentences.content: My father marks my height on the door every year.
sentences.english: My father marks my height on the door every year
sentences.chinese: 我父亲每年都会在门上标记我的身高。

wordDetails.definition: mark（第三人称单数现在时）: 标记

sentences.content: It's fun to look at the marks later.
sentences.english: It's fun to look at the marks later
sentences.chinese: 事后查看这些痕迹很有趣。

sentences.content: Next time, I also want to do something different.
sentences.english: Next time , I also want to do something different
sentences.chinese: 下次，我也想尝试些不一样的事情。
